body:
## What it does

Studies how the account owner already writes on X, then proposes a single fresh post each weekday alongside a short list of conversations worth joining. Everything is a suggestion waiting on approval: it is a writing desk rather than an autoposter. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @joshkim shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
